summary: Aermotor tower built 1921 on Maple Hill, moved to Bloss Mountain in 1939 and removed in 1986; no source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower was removed in 1986. No source I found describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Steel Aermotor tower built on Maple Hill, per the Maple Hill register entry
Moved from Maple Hill to Bloss Mountain and renamed
Stone observer's cabin being built near the tower, per the 1939 Wellsboro notice
Glen Campbell listed as towerman at Bloss Tower
Register says the steel tower was removed

evidence.supports: The steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921 and moved in 1939 to Bloss Mountain
evidence.quote: This steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921, and moved in 1939 and renamed Bloss Mountain.

evidence.supports: The Bloss Mountain register gives the tower as an Aermotor, moved from Maple Hill, and removed in 1986
evidence.quote: This steel Aermotor tower was built in 1939,moved from Maple Hill and removed in 1986.

evidence.supports: The tower was formerly located on Maple Hill
evidence.quote: The Bloss Mt. Tower was formerly located on Maple Hill.

evidence.supports: In 1939 the tower was 80 feet high
evidence.quote: Bloss Mountain Tower is 80 feet high, and will probably be a popular observation point because of its easy access and magnificent view.

evidence.supports: A stone cabin was being built near the tower for the observer in 1939
evidence.quote: An attractive stone cabin is now being built near the tower for the observer, who will be on duty four or five months a year.

evidence.supports: Tioga County had five fire towers in 1949, with Glen Campbell at Bloss Tower
evidence.quote: The Department has five fire towers in Tioga County.

evidence.supports: Glen Campbell was the towerman at Bloss Tower in 1949
evidence.quote: Glen Campbell at Bloss Tower on Bloss Mountain.

evidence.supports: The register lists the site under former fire lookout sites
evidence.quote: Bloss Mountain Tower Site | Former Fire Lookout Sites

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap has a point labelled Bloss Lookout Tower at the site

sources.title: Bloss Mountain (newspaper notices transcribed from 1921 to 1949)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Maple Hill register dates the steel Aermotor tower to 1921 and its move to 1939. The Bloss Mountain register gives 1939 as the build year. The story follows the Maple Hill register for 1921 and reads 1939 as the move.

notes_for_editor: Built and moved dates rest on two register entries plus a 1939 newspaper. Nothing found describes the site today. The OpenStreetMap node exists at 41.6203514, -77.1369155, close to the record's coordinates, but its tags do not show whether a structure stands. The record's elevation (718.4 m, register) differs from OSM (720 m); not material. Access not stated in any source read, so access is omitted.
